crossRefs.note: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.
Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow…
When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the congregation, and made him king over…
If this people goes up to offer sacrifices in Yahweh’s house at Jerusalem, then the heart of this people will turn…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jeroboam
people.line: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel.

people.name: Nebat
people.line: Father of Jeroboam, the first king of Israel.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up, and rebelled against his lord.
translations.bsb: Yet Jeroboam son of Nebat, a servant of Solomon son of David, rose up and rebelled against his master.
translations.kjv: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up, and hath rebelled against his lord.
translations.asv: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up, and rebelled against his lord.
